d.d: A country in West Asia. Official name: Islamic Republic of Iran. Capital: Tehran.
A member of the smaller of the two Zoroastrian communities of the Indian subcontinent.
Of or relating to Iran, its people or its culture.
Pertaining to the Iranian languages or their speakers.
A member of any of the various ethnic groups that speak the Iranian languages.
A country in West Asia in the Middle East. Official name: Republic of Iraq. Capital and largest city: Baghdad.
Of, from, or pertaining to Iraq, or the Iraqi people.
Of, from, or pertaining to Persian Iraq.
A person from Iraq or of Iraqi descent.
Easily provoked to outbursts of anger; irritable.
